name: Lead Scorer
summary: Every morning, score new HubSpot leads from 0 to 100 using company size and recent activity, explain each score, and post the top 5 to #sales.

items.title: HubSpot lead reader
items.description: Fetches new leads from HubSpot for daily scoring.
items.proved_when: New leads are successfully retrieved from HubSpot.

items.title: Lead scoring agent
items.description: Scores new leads from 0 to 100 using company size and recent activity, and explains each score.
items.proved_when: Leads are assigned a score between 0 and 100 with an explanation.
items.source_quote: score new HubSpot leads from 0 to 100 using company size and recent activity, explain each score

items.title: Slack poster
items.description: Posts the top 5 scored leads to the specified channel.
items.proved_when: A message containing the top 5 leads is sent to Slack.

items.title: Morning schedule
items.description: Triggers the lead scoring and posting process every morning.
items.proved_when: The workflow executes automatically every morning.

items.title: Scored leads table
items.description: Stores leads, their calculated scores, explanations, and posting status.
items.proved_when: Lead records and scores are saved in the database.

questions.text: Which Slack workspace should the top 5 leads be posted to?

not_in_this_version.title: CRM write-back
not_in_this_version.reason: The request only asked to post top leads to Slack and score them, not to update lead records back in HubSpot.
